x: Third from left: Alaster Stewart took leg 11 and ran a personal best for the long stage; the Belgrave lead went up to over 2 minutes. Sadly, Al became injured some time after this high and has yet to make a return to training.
In the 1500 Alaster Stewart led the chasing pack back to the runaway leader of Ealing & Southall but a Tonbridge athlete blasted down the home straight to take the front runner on the line.

Above: Stephen Sharp (stage 6), Phil Wicks (2), Jonathan Blackledge (5), Spencer Barden (4), Alaster Stewart (1) and Tim Watson (3) receive the Ian Logan Trophy – Belgrave’s fourth year of being top of the pile at Rushmoor Arena.  Only Stephen and Jonathan remained in the squad from 2004’s winning line-up.

Hopefully Alaster Stewart would now take us into the lead. In fact Al gained nine seconds on stage two leaders Harrow as the fancied Notts AC team came up four places behind him, Birchfield sagged to 16th and the Beagles advanced to 8th.
